== Biography ==
{{African-American Sticker}}
Thomas was born about 1850 in Pennsylvania.  He was the son of [[Unknown-413982|Mary]] and [[Glasgow-752|Robert Glasgow]], and the brother of Civil War veteran [[Glasgow-751|London Glasgow]] of the 54th Massachusetts Volunteer Infantry, the first regiment in the United States made up entirely of enlisted men of color.

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-752]] is assessed at 93% (proved). Thomas’s 1850 Pennsylvania birth and paired 1850/1860 West Marlborough family citations fit Robert’s youngest child slot. The explicitly documented sister Amy and consistent sibling narrative strengthen this family inference, although Thomas’s 1880 married household supplies no natal father clause.

Held citation and associated historical narrative address this selected father-child identity; no original was newly inspected.

Next useful test: Read Thomas’s death record or Robert’s probate naming Thomas.
